The '''father''' of [[Carnor Jax]] was a member of the [[Sun Guard]] of [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] and a secret agent of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="END" /> In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Sidious sent him to retrieve the [[Holocron of King Adas|holocron]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]] from the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] student [[Norval]].<ref name="END" /><ref name="Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref> The Guard found Norval over the planet [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]], and when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in pursuit of Norval, he attacked their vessel. However, he soon turned his guns on Norval's ship when it became apparent that the Jedi would get the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], and when they escaped with it, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] Norval.<ref name="Followers" /> Sidious later executed the Sun Guard agent for his failure.<ref name="END" />
